headline: Phase 0 under way: 4 benchmark tasks with exact verifiers, a model gateway and a sweep runner are in. Real model baselines are blocked on API keys.

blockers.title: No model API keys in the build environment
blockers.detail: Baselines (Phase 1) need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and/or OPENAI_API_KEY (or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as OpenRouter or a vLLM server). Add them as environment secrets in the Claude Code environment settings.

blockers.title: GitHub Pages must be enabled once
blockers.detail: Settings -> Pages -> Source: GitHub Actions. The repo is private, so Pages needs a plan that supports it (Pro/Team), and the published site is public. Allow branch claude/problem-decomposition-harness-q4dnyc in Settings -> Environments -> github-pages, or merge to main.

phases.title: Phase 0 · Eval harness
phases.exit: One command runs any model × task × complexity sweep and plots the curve.

items.text: Task interface: generate(complexity, seed) · verify(answer) · steps/corrupt
Tower of Hanoi (Illusion of Thinking) with exact simulator
Independent STRIPS checker cross-validates the Blocksworld verifier
Model gateway: Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, vLLM, disk cache, cost accounting
Sweep runner (resumable, parallel) + report → this site
Progress site on GitHub Pages, deployed by Actions

phases.title: Phase 1 · Baselines & collapse curves
phases.exit: Reproduced baseline table and curves; target known.

items.text: B0/B1: cheap models, direct and chain-of-thought
Fit per-step reliability p from collapse curves

phases.title: Phase 2 · Fixed-lens decomposition
phases.exit: H1 + H2 hold on Blocksworld and Faith & Fate.

items.text: Lenses: HTN, constraint propagation, change of basis
Solver / verifier roles with tool verifiers

phases.title: Phase 3 · Self-organizing swarm
phases.exit: H3 + H4 on ≥3/5 core benchmarks; H5 on ≥1.

items.text: Stigmergic work selection, bandit budget economy, adaptive split/merge

phases.title: Phase 4 · Lens invention & stretch
phases.exit: An invented lens beats every hand-made lens on a held-out family.

log.title: Phase 0 harness slice + progress site
log.body: Added the semantic Python package: Hanoi, Blocksworld, Mystery Blocksworld and multiplication tasks with exact verifiers; a model gateway; a resumable sweep runner; and a report step that feeds this page. Verifier self-checks: every reference answer accepted, every mutated answer rejected, zero disagreements between the Blocksworld verifier and an independent STRIPS simulator. Simulated noisy-oracle sweeps reproduce the p^n collapse through the real pipeline. 39 tests pass.

log.title: Design note
log.body: Thesis, decomposition lenses, architecture, benchmark selection and game plan published as plan.html.
